**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve logical newer inputs in the double-colon fallback**

In generated Ninja mode, a target with multiple double-colon groups still falls back to deferred `$?` expansion, whose `--internal-newer-inputs` helper drops nonexistent prerequisites. With the missing-output workaround also removed by this refactor, this now misses builds that previously worked: declare `.PHONY: force`, give `output:: force` the recipe `if test -n "$?"; then printf built > $@; fi`, and add `output::; @:`. Starting without `output`, the generated build succeeds without creating it; direct execution and the baseline generated build create it. Preserve logical/phony prerequisite handling in this fallback before removing its existing missing-output protection.

source_review: Detailed analysis and retained contracts: review.md inside the raw archive.
changes: Consolidated completed-node bookkeeping and removed the one-iteration scheduler loop and unused headers.
Removed repeated jobserver connection lookups, an unnecessary mutex and per-connection heap allocation.
Centralized spawn error checks and removed duplicate temporary recipe unlinks.
Removed temporary launch-plan string copies without changing its wire format.
Shared generation pinning/retry logic while preserving the saved-graph launcher.
Removed unused Makefile timestamps, empty out-of-line destruction, obsolete includes and a self-include.
Fixed the Codex-reported double-colon deferred $? bug, with logical/phony metadata and saved-graph compatibility.
Elided silent phony no-op shell launches while retaining dependency freshness, exports, custom shells/flags, visible commands and explicit Ninja metadata.
Removed empty first-generation legacy migration and redundant alias replacement while retaining all required durability barriers and atomic replacement of changed aliases.
Skipped native freshness probes for missing ordinary outputs in the existing recipe shell, preserving native checks for existing outputs and intermediate-consumer proof handling.

sanitizers.leak_detection: Session ownership unit uses detect_leaks=1; other suites use detect_leaks=0.

plan.exclusions: Only the two predeclared warmup pairs.
plan.reason: Requalification after skipping native freshness probes for missing ordinary outputs, while retaining intermediate-consumer proofs. Prior publication cleanup d4dca5f reduced filesystem work but its 1001-pair clean gate still failed at ratio 1.0210. The new guard removes 32 helper processes from that fixture; diagnostic execution improves. Counts, thresholds, stage order and maintenance controls remain unchanged from the publication plan. All prior failures remain retained.
plan.maintenance: Retire completed main-matrix synthetic fixtures between stages, retaining verified copies of all command logs, outside measured pairs.

cells.evidence_source: All original 101 pairs plus the one fixed 900-pair precision extension.
All original 101 pairs plus the one fixed 900-pair precision extension.
All original 101 pairs plus the one fixed 900-pair precision extension.
All original 101 pairs plus the one fixed 900-pair precision extension.

precision_plan.reason: The original completed campaign passes 58/60 cells. These timing medians narrowly exceed parity while both confidence intervals cross 1. This one fixed extension increases precision without changing code or thresholds. No additional extension will be used to seek a passing result.
precision_plan.order: Alternating b/c and c/b, as in the original campaign
precision_plan.exclusions: Only each stage's two predeclared warmup pairs. All 101 original measured pairs remain in the pooled estimate.
precision_plan.between_stage_maintenance: After nested sampling completes, pause only during the clean-stage warmups to retire completed main-matrix fixtures with verified log copies. No measured clean pair may span maintenance. The plan, maintenance script and record are retained.

precision_maintenance.reason: Release completed synthetic main fixtures between precision stages; retain and verify their command logs. Only clean-stage warmup timing can include the pause.

previous_publication_clean_gate.remaining_stages: Not run after the first clean gate failed.

cleanup_control.interpretation: No supported timing regression in the same-environment control; wide intervals prevent using it as strict acceptance.

interruption.reason: Paused before any later performance stage. Finish the active main matrix, then stop this campaign to validate explicit Ninja metadata eligibility. No tests or source rebuild overlap its active measurements.
interruption.stopped_after: completed main matrix, all 30 cells pass
interruption.remaining_stages: not run; metadata regression coverage required a source correction

incomplete_attempt.reason: Filesystem inode exhaustion invalidated the first performance attempt; reports could not be completed. Restart the full unchanged plan after removing reproducible historical fixtures.

limits: Synthetic cloud measurements against original baseline 77a397f; real PC qualification remains unrun.
RSS is peak individual-process memory, not simultaneous process-tree memory; small cases can be masked by the parent/exec high-water floor.

The first benchmark attempt exhausted workspace inodes and is retained as incomplete evidence. Emergency inode recovery removed one warmup fixture and its per-fixture logs; its recorded samples and command journal remain. Subsequent fixture retirement preserved samples, reports and surviving command logs.
The initial external-container startup for the fixed runtime used the wrong entrypoint and failed before any test ran; its log is retained alongside the completed explicit-entrypoint campaign.
The first no-op test draft omitted the inherited export expansion on its prerequisite. The corrected expectation was verified against the pre-optimization binary before testing the change.

The first depfile test draft incorrectly expected evaluation-time file I/O during Ninja generation. The corrected dependency-log test passes before optimization, fails on 5302d4f and passes after the metadata fix. Its original and corrected reproduction logs are retained.

The 5302d4f performance campaign completed its 30-cell main matrix and was intentionally stopped before remaining stages after manual review reproduced metadata regressions; it does not qualify the final runtime.

Prior runtime f1ee1a2 initially passed 58/60 cells. Its one fixed precision extension retained the original samples and confirmed a 3.3% small clean regression, leaving 59/60 passing cells. Publication-only runtime d4dca5f still failed its clean gate at +2.1%; both failures remain retained. The final runtime receives a fresh predeclared campaign after removing missing-output probe processes.

Completed synthetic main-matrix fixtures were retired between precision stages with verified command-log copies. Only clean-stage warmup timing can include the maintenance pause; no measured pair spans it.
Earlier runtime results remain historical and do not qualify subsequent code. No per-cell threshold was relaxed.
